title: HistoryMediaService
responsibility: Resolves the media of attached records and legacy reports into a content-addressed output directory.

inputs.name: HistoryMediaService.constructor.out
inputs.description: Root directory for placed media. When matching bytes are stored, the service writes their content-addressed file beneath this directory; the constructor does not validate the path.

inputs.name: HistoryMediaService.place.bytes
inputs.description: Original capture bytes, or undefined when they are unavailable. Matching bytes are written once per content-addressed media path; missing or hash-mismatched bytes produce the supplied gap result.

inputs.name: HistoryMediaService.place.file
inputs.description: Metadata for a capture file, with its path and SHA-256 digest. The digest is compared with the supplied bytes; the path's final alphanumeric extension is lowercased for the output name, or bin is used when there is no matching extension.

inputs.name: HistoryMediaService.place.gap
inputs.description: Caller-supplied reason text for unavailable or hash-mismatched bytes. The service returns it unchanged when the bytes are missing or their digest differs from the file digest.

outputs.name: HistoryMediaService.place
outputs.description: Resolved media result for the capture. Matching bytes produce a relative media/<sha256>.<extension> path; missing or mismatched bytes produce media: null with the supplied gap, and paths without a matching extension use bin.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The asynchronous operation rejects with the filesystem error if creating a destination directory or writing a media file fails; the service does not catch it.
